source.title: Funding source
source.description: Who will cover the expenses for this trip?
source.label: Primary funding source

context.self: You'll fund the trip from your own resources. Your bank statement and income show the funds are available — there's no sponsor to document.
context.sponsor: Someone else will fund the trip. Their sponsorship letter, bank statement, and proof of your relationship document who is supporting you and how.
context.employer: Your employer will cover the trip (for example, business travel). Employer confirmation of coverage documents this; personal-bank evidence is less central.
context.mixed: You and a sponsor will share the costs. Note clearly which expenses you cover and which your sponsor covers, and prepare evidence for both.

personal.title: Personal finances
personal.description: Your own funds available for this trip
personal.balanceHint: This figure is only recorded for your own reference. It is never judged as sufficient or insufficient.

income.title: Income overview
income.description: Read from your Employment section — nothing to enter here.
income.none: No employment income is recorded yet. Add it in the Employment section if it applies to you.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.description: People contributing to the trip, summarized here. Add and edit them in the Sponsors workspace.
sponsors.noneHint: You chose funding that involves a sponsor. Add at least one sponsor so their support can be documented.
sponsors.noDocuments: No sponsor documents on file yet

documents.none: No financial documents apply to your current funding source.

gather.title: Financial evidence to gather
gather.description: The financial documents not yet in hand. Copy the list to share with yourself, a sponsor, or a family member.
gather.heading: Financial evidence to gather
gather.empty: All applicable financial evidence is in hand — nothing left to gather.

consistency.title: Consistency
consistency.description: Factual relationships between the sections you've filled in. Nothing here predicts an outcome.
consistency.allClear: Your funding, income, and evidence are consistent so far.
consistency.employmentIncomeSupports: Your employment income (from the Employment section) supports your declared self-funding.
consistency.noEmploymentIncomeOnRecord: No employment income is recorded in the Employment section. If you're employed, adding it helps your funding line up.
consistency.bankStatementPending: Your self-funding relies on a bank statement, which isn't ready yet.
consistency.mixedWhoCovers: For mixed funding, note clearly which costs you cover and which your sponsor covers.
consistency.employerCovers: This trip is recorded as employer-funded. Prepare your employer's confirmation that it covers the costs.

why.title: Why do we ask this?
why.bankName: Naming the bank that holds your funds lets your statement line up with your declared account.
why.accountBalance: Recording the balance is for your own reference only — it helps you keep track, and is never judged.
why.statementDate: A recent statement date shows the funds are current.

guidance.bankStatementDemonstrates: A recent bank statement demonstrates that funds are available for the trip.
guidance.salaryAccountConsistency: If your salary arrives in this account, the statement ties your income to your available funds.
guidance.sponsorLetterDemonstrates: A sponsorship letter documents who is supporting you, and their bank statement shows the funds are available.
guidance.employerCoverageContext: For an employer-funded trip, a letter confirming the employer covers your costs is the key piece of evidence.
guidance.evidenceFromDocuments: These come from your Documents workspace — this page reflects their status, it doesn't store a separate copy.

personal.title: No personal-bank evidence needed
personal.description: Your funding source doesn't rely on your own bank funds. Anything you entered before is kept if you change the source later.

sponsors.title: No sponsors needed
sponsors.description: You chose funding that doesn't involve a sponsor. You can add one anytime by changing the funding source.

documents.title: No financial documents needed
documents.description: Your funding source doesn't require financial documents here. Any required documents live in the Documents workspace.
